label: Bible Study
prompt: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more _____.
verse: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
note: The thief takes; the Good Shepherd gives life — and more of it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be _____.
verse: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
note: A Beatitude that sounds backwards: the mourners are the blessed ones, because comfort is coming.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of _____.
verse: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
note: Lot's wife looked back at Sodom and became a pillar of salt — Jesus later warned simply, 'Remember Lot's wife.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a _____, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verse: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
note: The Servant's resolve — echoed when Luke says Jesus 'stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had _____ of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verse: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
note: The men of Issachar 'had understanding of the times' — every leadership sermon's favorite tribe.
